description: Drive Adobe Illustrator and After Effects, and move artwork between them as editable shape layers.
name: io.github.VicThor-wpp/mograph-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Which tool families to expose: ai, ae, symbiosis, dev, or all. A session that only touches one application pays roughly half the tools/list.
environmentVariables.name: MOGRAPH_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Port of the local WebSocket bridge the After Effects CEP panel connects to. Must match the port the panel was installed with.
environmentVariables.name: MOGRAPH_WS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to remove ai_run_script and ae_run_script, which evaluate arbitrary ExtendScript inside the applications.
environmentVariables.name: MOGRAPH_ALLOW_RAW_SCRIPT
